blue_droplets.ponder.sand_filter.header: Purifying Water with a Sand Filter
blue_droplets.ponder.sand_filter.text_1: A Sand Filter purifies by one step water pumped through it
blue_droplets.ponder.sand_filter.text_2: Dirty Water needs to be pumped in from the top...
blue_droplets.ponder.sand_filter.text_3: and Purified Water can be pumped out from the bottom
blue_droplets.ponder.sand_filter.text_4: A Wrench turns the filter: water always leaves on the side the bottom faces
blue_droplets.ponder.sand_filter.text_5: Filters placed in a row facing the same way pass their water on, one step purer each
